title: "Masks and Dances" – Nour Ayadi, Piano solo
desc: The French-American Piano Society proudly presents: “Masks and Dances” – Nour Ayadi, Piano solo, a recital including pieces by Rameau, Couperin, Royer, Poulenc, Stravinsky, Debussy, Granados and Brahms. French-Moroccan pianist Nour Ayadi began playing the piano at the age of 6 in her native country before continuing her studies in France at the École Normale de Musique de Paris, and later at the Conservatoire National Supérieur de Musique de Paris, where she graduated with the highest honors. She also was an Artist-In-Residence at the Queen Elisabeth Music Chapel and the Haute École de Musique
